DuoAero 1.3.5 is an A-channel development update based on the original Duolingo 6.103.5 runtime. It is not a finished implementation of all requested features.

Word-gap answers are aligned with the surrounding sentence. More fractions and indexed expressions use mathematical notation, including the ideal-gas density example and reviewed gravity choices. One long ISA pressure problem is split into consecutive calculations. The launcher uses a front-facing aviator Snoopy and the splash image has additional safe-area padding. Additional visible plural labels are rebranded.

Several original celebration scenes now use transparent, frame-by-frame Snoopy animations, and three original lesson characters have Peanuts replacements with separate correct and incorrect poses. An original flying scene uses an animated Snoopy biplane while keeping its heart and trail. Other characters, animations and emotions still need to be adapted.

On an Android emulator, the word-gap alignment was checked at an S24-like resolution and in dark mode; a diagnostic lesson accepted 20 answers, and account-storage and legacy-completion checks passed. These results do not establish a complete course traversal or physical Samsung acceptance. Standalone progress, the production-signed build and the update installation must be checked separately against their corresponding evidence.

Still incomplete: the show-formula feature and its delayed retry behavior, prerequisites for every calculation, division of all long calculations, the remaining character and animation replacements, a full mathematical-notation audit, real Google/Drive sign-in and sync, updater installation verification, and physical sound and vibration checks.

`build-info.json` identifies the signing source and `SHA256SUMS.txt` identifies the signed APK. `build-1.3.5` is unsigned signing input and cannot be installed.
